# Welcome to my website!
My name is Joshua Dantus! I am a Masters student in the Applied Anatomy program at Case Western Reserve
University School of Medicine. I completed my undergraduate education at Brown University, where I studied Biology and Music.
My experiences in emergency medical services, biological research, education, and community service have strengthened my commitment to becoming a clinician. I am particularly interested in compassionate, patient-centered care and the ways healthcare systems can improve access and outcomes for diverse communities.
